# Chargeback Analysis: Consumer Disputes and Fraud categories account for majority of dispute volume and dollars

Consumer Disputes and Fraud reason categories drove disputes, representing 93% of total volume (336 of 362 disputes) and 93% of disputed dollars ($205K of $220K) in the latest period.

| Reason Category | Disputes | Disputed $ | Win Rate | Friendly Fraud Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Consumer Disputes | 210 [F2] | $125K [F2] | 53.0% [F2] | 0.0% [F2] |
| Fraud | 126 [F4] | $79K [F4] | 44.1% [F4] | 100.0% [F4] |
| Processing Errors | 26 [F6] | $15K [F6] | 50.0% [F6] | 0.0% [F6] |

- **Consumer Disputes** volume flat at 210 disputes [F1][F2], but win rate declined from 56.7% [F1] to 53.0% [F2] (resolved disputes only for latest month); disputed dollars decreased 3% from $129K [F1] to $125K [F2]
- **Fraud** disputes remained stable at 126 cases [F3][F4] with 100.0% friendly fraud rate [F3][F4]; win rate improved from 42.1% [F3] to 44.1% [F4] (resolved disputes only for latest month); disputed dollars decreased 2% from $81K [F3] to $79K [F4]
- **Processing Errors** volume steady at 26 disputes [F5][F6], but win rate dropped from 65.4% [F5] to 50.0% [F6] (resolved disputes only for latest month); CFPB complaints (market-wide monthly benchmark) were 4,155 [F1][F3][F5] in earliest month and 4,213 [F2][F4][F6] in latest month

## Data Coverage
Analysis period: 2024-07-31 to 2026-06-30
